en.title: Soup for one, made slowly
en.excerpt: A quiet evening, a single pot, and the kind of cooking that needs no audience.
en.content:
A quiet evening, a single pot, and the kind of cooking that needs no audience. Onions first, then carrots, then whatever was left in the crisper drawer without complaint.

The soup simmered for an hour while I read by the window. No recipe, no measurement — just heat, time, and a wooden spoon.

It was enough for one bowl and one person. That was exactly right.
en.author: June Marsk
